data.description: Anthropic has announced the launch of its latest AI model, Claude Sonnet 4.5.

Nano Banana 2 offers pay-per-use resources, making billing more convenient.
Nano Banana 2 incorporates the high-speed intelligence of Gemini Flash into the field of visual generation, enabling rapid editing and iteration. It makes previously exclusive Pro-level functions accessible to a wider range of users, including: 
Advanced world knowledge: This model is extracted from Gemini's real-world knowledge base and is supported by real-time information and images from the internet, enabling a more accurate presentation of specific topics. This profound understanding ability can also help you create infographics, convert notes into charts, and generate data visualizations. 
Precise text rendering and translation: Nano Banana 2 enables you to generate accurate and clear text for marketing prototypes or greeting cards. You can even translate and localize the text in images, allowing you to share your creativity globally.

Sora 2 is a new generation video generation model released by OpenAI. It is the first to support AI audio generation that matches the visuals, and it has also been launched as an iOS application called Sora (Sora 2 serves as the technical foundation of the Sora APP).

Claude Haiku 4.5 demonstrates near-cutting-edge performance across a wide range of usage scenarios, and stands out as one of the best programming and agent models - its speed and cost are perfectly balanced, capable of supporting free products and high-traffic user experiences.

The latest generation of general-purpose large models designed for complex tasks and production environments has been comprehensively enhanced in terms of inference depth, instruction compliance, multimodal understanding, and stability. It is suitable for complex analysis, Agent workflows, and high-demand enterprise-level applications.

Kimi K2.5 is the flagship open-source multi-modal language model product launched by Moonshot AI. It is the most intelligent model of Kimi to date, achieving the open-source state-of-the-art performance in Agent, code, visual understanding, and a series of general intelligent tasks. At the same time, Kimi K2.5 is also the most all-round model of Kimi to date. With its native multi-modal architecture design, it supports visual and text input, thinking and non-thinking modes, dialogue and Agent tasks. Its core positioning is "native visual intelligent agent engine", specifically designed for coding, office work, and complex task autonomous collaboration. 
Performance breakthrough: Exhibits outstanding performance in the HLE, BrowseComp, and SWE-Verified three major intelligent agent benchmarks, with costs significantly lower than those of competitors.
Architectural innovation: The world's first open-source model that supports self-organizing "agent swarm" (Agent Swarm), capable of dynamically scheduling up to 100 sub-intelligent agents and executing up to 1,500 tool calls in parallel.
Coding revolution: The strongest open-source multimodal encoding model, capable of directly generating front-end interfaces with interactive animations from conversations or videos, achieving "what you see is what you get" visual programming.
Office efficiency improvement: End-to-end processing of 10,000-word documents, hundreds of pages of reports, financial models, and LaTeX formulas. Complex office tasks are reduced from hourly to minute-level processing time.
Efficiency leap: Compared to a single intelligent agent, the swarm mode reduces execution time by up to 80%, compresses key path steps by 3-4.5 times, and truly achieves "instant response".

DeepSeek-V3.2 is the official version of the model that incorporates DeepSeek Sparse Attention (a type of sparse attention mechanism). It is also the first model launched by DeepSeek that integrates thinking into the use of tools, and it supports both thinking mode and non-thinking mode tool invocation.

The brand-new Claude Opus 4.6 has further enhanced its coding capabilities compared to its predecessors. It has a more meticulous planning, can execute autonomous tasks for a longer duration, operates more reliably in larger code bases, and possesses stronger code review and debugging capabilities, enabling it to promptly identify and correct its own errors. Additionally, as the first attempt in our Opus series models, Opus 4.6 is equipped with a 1 million-tagged context window in the beta version.

Running production tasks with Opus 4.7 resulted in a 3-fold increase in solution rate and a "more than 10-fold improvement" in code quality. In multi-task workflows, Opus 4.7 was 14% better than 4.6, with a reduction of approximately one-third in tool invocation error rate and a decrease in token consumption.

The Gemini 3 Flash demonstrates that speed and scale do not necessarily come at the expense of intelligence. It achieves cutting-edge levels in doctoral-level reasoning and knowledge benchmark tests, such as GPQA Diamond (90.4%) and the "Ultimate Human Test" (33.7% without the use of tools), and its performance can rival that of larger leading models, and significantly outperforms even the best 2.5 version model - Gemini 2.5 Pro - in multiple benchmark tests. Moreover, on the MMMU Pro, it also reaches the industry's top level, achieving an outstanding 81.2% result, comparable to Gemini 3 Pro.

MiniMax offers a variety of text models to meet the needs of different scenarios. MiniMax-M2.5 has achieved or surpassed the state-of-the-art (SOTA) in productivity scenarios such as programming, tool invocation and search, and office work. MiniMax-M2 is specifically designed for efficient coding and Agent workflows.

Anthropic has announced the launch of the artificial intelligence model Claude Sonnet 4.6, stating that this model has achieved comprehensive upgrades in coding capabilities, computer operations, long-context reasoning, agent planning, knowledge work, and design domains. The beta version also includes a context window of 1 million tokens.

Gemini 3 Pro Preview (version identifier: gemini-3-pro-preview-11-2025) is the latest generation flagship artificial intelligence model launched by Google. As the third-generation product of the Gemini series, it is regarded as a top-level model competing with GPT-5 and Claude 4.5, aiming to redefine the "thinking" and "collaboration" methods of AI through stronger reasoning capabilities, an extremely long context window, and deep multimodal interaction.

GPT-5.2-Chat is a lightweight and efficient version of the language model series products launched by OpenAI. Its core positioning is to be an ultra-fast intelligent assistant for daily work and study, emphasizing rapid response and clear, practical output. It is suitable for common question answering, writing and task guidance scenarios. Ultra-fast response experience: Optimized for regular conversations and retrieval question-and-answer scenarios, suitable for quick feedback on questions. Enhancement of daily task capabilities: More proficient in information retrieval, how-to guidance, writing assistance and clear semantic expression compared to the previous generation. Stable general performance: Suitable for general work and study scenarios, such as knowledge queries, text polishing, translation, etc. Natural conversation style: Continues to maintain a more friendly tone and more readable output. Rich practical scenarios: Suitable for content creation, task organization, proposal of brief plans, etc., for frequent light work processes.

GPT-5.2-Codex is an intelligent agent programming model released by OpenAI. Its foreign name is... This model was officially launched on December 18, 2025, and is mainly applied in software engineering and cybersecurity defense in complex real-world scenarios.

MiniMax-M2.1 has a total of 204,800 input and output tokens, offering strong multilingual programming capabilities and a comprehensive upgrade to the programming experience (with an output speed of approximately 60 tps)
Intelligent and efficient, currently the model with the best performance globally in terms of encoding, intelligent agents, and computer applications. Maximum output: 64K tokens.
